title: Introducing AgentHub: Booking.com Platform for Modular Travel AI Agents
summary: Authors:   Moran Beladev ,  Hadas Harush ,  Chana Ross      At Booking.com we developed AgentHub, a platform to power intelligent, modular, and multi-modal travel experiences through LLM-driven agents. Our platform provides configurable agents capable of performing a wide range of tasks, along with out-of-the-box agent management and monitoring capabilities. With AgentHub, different teams can build and deploy AI agents in a matter of hours, based on configuration and reusable components.  Background  As AI capabilities continue to advance rapidly, agentic AI is becoming a defining force in the technology landscape. Unlike traditional generative systems, agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) with iterative planning, autonomous decision-making, and the ability to take action through tools. By enabling direct interaction with internal systems and APIs, these agents can leverage proprietary data and orchestrate workflows end to end —  unlocking deeper contextual understanding and highly personalized user experiences.     The Evolution from Generative AI to Agentic AI ( source )   To support a wide range of GenAI use cases at Booking.com, from simple LLM-powered features to fully agentic capabilities, we built the  AgentHub platform.  AgentHub enables rapid agent creation through configuration-driven setups, backed by robust shared infrastructure. This approach democratizes GenAI across the company, empowering diverse roles such as UX writers, product managers, developer
